headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with AI driving profit gains but guidance trimmed for some majors.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and Coforge, while Infosys and Wipro saw modest or declining profits. AI‑related revenue contributed significantly across the sector, especially at HCLTech and Mphasis. Guidance was cut for Infosys but raised for Coforge.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, boosting profits and deal wins.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance, while Coforge raised its EBIT margin outlook.

themes.title: Profit momentum
themes.detail: HCLTech posted a 21% profit jump; Coforge and Tech Mahindra also delivered strong profit growth.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance
11.5% YoY revenue growth with 21% profit increase and strong AI revenue

laggards.why: Only 1.5% YoY revenue growth and trimmed FY27 guidance
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% YoY
